repos_data.description: Free, two-way Figma MCP server. Turn designs into framework-aware code, and push code back to the canvas. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and any MCP client.
The design system infrastructure keeping teams and agents in sync.

MCP server + CLI for AI-powered design fidelity — compare Figma designs or screenshots against rendered UI. 90% mutation recall, zero false positives on a golden eval set. No API keys — uses your Claude Code or Codex subscription.

Use existing brand guidelines with AI. Turn websites, PDFs, and Figma into a portable .brand runtime through MCP.

Git-native context layer for AI coding agents. Your team's real engineering decisions — patterns, pitfalls, conventions — live as reviewed markdown files in your repo; agents consult them before writing code and record what they learn. Files-first, no server required; MCP as an optional serving layer.

Local-first MCP server that gives coding agents structured context packets, code/schema facts, and diagnostics - backed by a local SQLite store.
